baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَذَّبُوا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي أَمْرٍ مَرِيجٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: An arrived reality that is fixed and reality-matching is actively classed as false; the فَهُمْ sequence then presents their own affair, not the truth, as mixed and unable to settle into a clear course.

activation_trace.role: Attribution to falsehood makes كَذَّبُوا an active reclassification rather than mere failure to know.
Fixed correspondence with reality supplies the stable object that their verdict does not destabilize.
Actual coming and obtaining turns truth from an abstract option into an encountered arrival.
The branch of affair and condition locates the resulting damage in their operative state.
Mixture, disturbance, and obscured exit give that state its internally disordered mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They denied the truth and consequently were confused.
changed_reading.after: They verdict an encountered, stable reality false, and that act leaves their own practical affair mixed, unstable, and without a clear exit.

baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant martial image treats denial as a charge that fails to carry through when a straight, penetrating claim actually arrives; the decision process then wobbles in place and twists away from a line.

activation_trace.role: A charge that proves false by losing nerve supplies the image of commitment that does not carry through.
A straight thrust that penetrates supplies a deliberately exploratory image for truth's uncompromised pressure.
Concrete arrival marks the point of contact at which commitment is tested.
Consultation and management of judgment make the disturbed affair a failed decision process.
An object wobbling in its setting models judgment that cannot hold position.
A twisted shaft or interlaced branch adds deviation from a straight course to mere indecision.

changed_reading.before: They merely hold an incorrect opinion.
changed_reading.after: At contact with a claim that presses straight through, they fail to carry a judgment through; deliberation loses its axis, oscillates, and bends off course.

baseline_models.mechanism: The fixed truth is handled as though it were one litigant's right-claim: they assign it falsehood, and what should be deliberation becomes an adversarial mixture of incompatible claims.

activation_trace.role: Assigning falsehood functions as their adversarial ruling on the arrived claim.
Mutual right-claiming opens a forensic branch in which each side alleges that truth is with it.
Arrival places the claim before them for response rather than leaving it hypothetical.
Consultation and management of opinion supply the forum that should resolve the claim.
Mixed and obstructed affairs describe a forum in which rival claims no longer converge.

changed_reading.before: Their uncertainty is private and undifferentiated.
changed_reading.after: Their disorder is also forensic and social: they demote arrived truth into one disputed claim among others, corrupting the process that could settle the matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah sequence places the mixed human affair inside an ordered evidence system: a preserved writing precedes the focus, then hidden self-speech and emitted words are watched and held ready. Their أمر can be mixed without becoming illegible or lost.

activation_trace.role: Active attribution to falsehood identifies an accountable act rather than an unrecordable mood.
Affair and condition provide the human domain whose apparent disorder is being measured.
Mixture and obstructed exit characterize their state but do not imply absent evidence.
Organized writing supplies a stable external form in which otherwise dispersed particulars cohere.
Guarding and preservation prevent the record from sharing the instability of their affair.
Hidden self-talk extends legibility inward to the private source of a judgment.
The mind and inward awareness locate that hidden speech within the judging self.
Speech emitted by the tongue carries the inner process into an observable act.
Watching and waiting supply continuous attention to what is emitted.
Presence in readiness makes the evidence available rather than deferred or scattered.

structural_cues: 50:4 places a preserving book immediately before the focus; 50:16-18 then moves from inward whisper to outward word and ready watcher.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preserved writing, known self-whisper, emitted speech, and ready surveillance; I infer that these form one scale-crossing evidence chain that contains the mريج affair. A live alternative is that the passages assert exhaustive knowledge independently, without defining the focus disorder.

changed_reading.before: Their mixed affair is opaque and therefore evidentially indeterminate.
changed_reading.after: Their affair is mixed from their side yet fully legible from outside it: denial develops from private speech into public utterance within a preserved, ready record.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joined construction, absence of gaps, fixed anchoring, and orderly stacking establish a material grammar of fit. Against it, مريج as a twisted or interlaced branch marks local misalignment in their affair rather than disorder in the reality they reject.

activation_trace.role: Tightly made weaving or speech gives الحق a branch image of internal construction and fit.
Interlaced growth and a bent shaft supply the counterimage of entanglement without alignment.
Building by joining part to part establishes constructive coherence as the surrounding material norm.
An opening or gap names precisely the structural failure denied of the sky.
Fixity and rooted stability add a grounded axis to the world around the wobbling affair.
Joining item to item in ordered arrangement makes productive multiplicity distinct from confused mixture.

structural_cues: 50:6-10 moves from a built sky without fissures to anchored earth, paired growth, and stacked fruit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fit, gaplessness, anchoring, stacking, and the focus's bent/interlaced branch image; I infer a contrast that diagnoses their affair by the coherent world around it. A live alternative is that these scenes argue only for resurrection and are not metaphors for 50:5 cognition.

changed_reading.before: مريج suggests that reality itself has become confusing.
changed_reading.after: The surrounding reality remains joined, anchored, and ordered; مريج instead names the deniers' loss of fit with that order, like a shaft bent off its line.

context_deltas.mechanism: The historical sequence converts epistemic rejection into accrued liability: denial targets sent messages, and the threatened consequence becomes due. The focus الحق therefore carries both reality-match and an enforceable claim that denial cannot cancel.

activation_trace.role: Assigning falsehood identifies the act repeated in the historical sequence.
Obligation and fixed entitlement allow الحق to develop from true content into a due consequence.
Messenger and message specify the transmitted object repeatedly subjected to denial.
Threat and warning supply the adverse consequence that can become binding and due.

structural_cues: 50:12-14 repeats denial across communities and closes with فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ, reusing both focus roots in a consequence formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sent messages, repeated denial, threat, and the statement that the threat became due; I infer that the focus الحق already bears a latent claim upon its hearers. A live alternative is that الحق in 50:5 remains purely propositional and the later due-ness is a separate result.

changed_reading.before: They reject a true proposition and suffer subjective confusion.
changed_reading.after: They reject a message whose truth also establishes a claim upon them; their mixed affair unfolds inside a consequence that their verdict cannot void.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus mixture is relocated from the object to the perceiver: confusion is a covering condition, followed later by removal of the covering and newly penetrating sight. The truth stays fixed while access to it changes.

activation_trace.role: Reality-matching fixity keeps the denied object stable across changing states of perception.
Mixture and obscured exit identify the present experiential state to be explained.
Mixture that produces mistaken identification gives an explicit cognitive analogue for مريج.
Inattention that leaves something outside awareness explains why an available truth is not properly received.
Lifting a cover supplies the reversal mechanism without requiring any change in the covered object.
A covering of ignorance names the barrier whose removal ends the prior mixture.
Insight of the heart broadens the later sight from optics to apprehension.
A sharp, penetrating edge makes the post-unveiling perception decisive rather than merely clearer.

structural_cues: 50:15 says they are in لَبْسٍ; 50:22 stages prior heedlessness, removal of a covering, and suddenly sharp sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confusion, heedlessness, a cover, its removal, and sharpened perception; I infer that these retrospectively anatomize مريج as a receiver-side condition. A live alternative is that 50:22 describes only a later eschatological transition, not the mechanism of 50:5.

changed_reading.before: The truth is hard to distinguish because the available evidence is objectively mixed.
changed_reading.after: Their own covering mixes categories and blocks an exit; when it is removed, the same reality becomes sharply penetrable without itself having changed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah contrast distinguishes two kinds of movement: مريج wobbles in place, whereas the منيب heart repeatedly returns toward a direction. The defect is thus not movement or revision itself, but motion without a governing destination.

activation_trace.role: Wobbling in one's setting supplies undirected motion that never stabilizes into return.
Deliberation makes changes of mind part of the affair, allowing direction rather than immobility to be the criterion.
Repeated return to a place or direction gives recurrent movement a stable orientation.
Turning something from its face allows the heart's change to be an active reorientation rather than random fluctuation.

structural_cues: مُنِيب frames the receptive servant in 50:8 and recurs with the heart in 50:33, enclosing much of the surah's argument.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wobble, recurrent return, and a turning heart; I infer that destination differentiates receptive revision from confused oscillation. A live alternative is that منيب names devotion without offering a kinetic contrast to مريج.

changed_reading.before: A stable reader never changes position, while confusion means any movement at all.
changed_reading.after: The focus condemns motion without orientation: fruitful judgment can turn repeatedly when each turn is a return, while the denied affair merely wobbles in place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The forensic baseline becomes temporal: rival claims continue into explicit disputation, but the authoritative word is not replaceable. مريج describes the disputants' proliferating case, not a truth that remains negotiable forever.

activation_trace.role: Competing assertions of right give the focus a live litigation frame.
Consultation and management of opinion locate the forum that degenerates into contention.
Mixed affairs with no visible exit capture the proliferating positions of the disputants.
Contention between adversaries realizes the social mechanism latent in competing truth-claims.
One thing replacing another names the operation explicitly denied of the final word.

structural_cues: 50:27-29 stages accusation, counterclaim, a ban on disputing, and the declaration that the word is not replaced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adversarial contention and non-replacement of the word; I infer that these resolve the focus's contested-right mechanism by separating noisy litigation from fixed adjudication. A live alternative is that the later dispute concerns blame only and does not retrospectively color 50:5.

changed_reading.before: The mixed affair is an open-ended contest in which truth remains one revisable claim.
changed_reading.after: Their claims can multiply into dispute, but they cannot substitute a new word for the fixed one; the instability belongs to the litigants, not the adjudicated truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth's coming is expanded into a communication sequence: receptive hearing joined to presence can still take heed, then a raised call culminates in a cry that is heard in truth. Denial is therefore a disordered mode of reception, not lack of signal.

activation_trace.role: Arrival initiates an encounter whose reception can be traced through later modes of hearing.
The falsehood verdict is the failed response to what has reached them.
Mixture and blocked exit move from generic confusion to a malfunction in uptake.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the receptive alternative to denial.
Presence with witnessing requires attention to accompany hearing rather than sound alone.
Raised voice and call increase the signal from arrived message to public summons.
The alarming cry marks reception that can no longer be postponed or treated as inaudible.

structural_cues: 50:37 joins a heart or cast hearing with witnessing; 50:41 commands listening; 50:42 says they hear the cry بِالْحَقِّ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies understanding-hearing, witnessing presence, a raised call, and an alarming cry; I infer an escalation from voluntary reception to unavoidable reception that begins with the focus arrival. A live alternative is that the final cry is only a future event and not a commentary on how the earlier truth was received.

changed_reading.before: Truth arrived once, but its communication may have been too ambiguous to settle anything.
changed_reading.after: The signal progresses from message to attentive hearing to public call to unavoidable cry; what becomes mixed is their uptake, not the communicative availability of truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing scene permits maximal material separation, the earth splitting apart, yet immediately converts it into directed collection accomplished with ease. This limits مريج: even actual fragmentation does not imply ontological chaos or failed reassembly.

activation_trace.role: Confused mixture and an obscured exit supply the human condition whose scope is being limited.
Entanglement and crookedness provide a spatial foil for the final directed movement.
Splitting and opening depict real separation more radical than the focus's cognitive mixture.
Driving and collecting a group toward a destination turns separation into convergent motion.
Opening and ease after difficulty deny that the gathering mechanism shares their blocked exit.

structural_cues: 50:44 compresses earth-splitting, rapid emergence, directed gathering, and ease into one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies splitting, collection toward a goal, and ease; I infer that this closing reversal confines مريج to human orientation rather than divine capacity or creation's recoverability. A live alternative is that the verse answers only the resurrection objection of 50:3 and leaves 50:5's disorder unqualified.

changed_reading.before: مريج may describe a universe whose scattered elements cannot be brought back into order.
changed_reading.after: Even split matter moves rapidly into an easy, directed gathering; the unresolved entanglement is their present affair, not any failure of reality to converge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final denial that the messenger is a coercer contains the focus's causality: truth genuinely arrives and commands response, but assent is not forced. Their mixed affair can therefore be read as the produced shape of unforced refusal, not confusion imposed by the message.

activation_trace.role: Arrival gives the truth real presence without by itself specifying compelled uptake.
Command and obligation keep the arrived truth normatively demanding even when assent is not forced.
The resulting mixture is assigned to their affair as the aftermath of response.
Overpowering compulsion names the relation explicitly denied of the messenger.

structural_cues: 50:45 negates coercive control over the hearers and immediately retains reminder by the recitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a demanding arrival, denial of messenger-compulsion, and continued reminder; I infer that the disorder develops through responsible but unforced response. A live alternative is that جبار only limits the messenger's office and says nothing about the causal psychology of 50:5.

changed_reading.before: The force of truth's arrival itself overwhelms them into confusion.
changed_reading.after: Truth arrives with a claim but without coerced assent; their mixed affair is the shape their unforced rejection takes, while reminder remains possible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from the conventional mixed-affair branch into pasture and authority imagery; it remains anchored directly in أَمْرٍ مَرِيجٍ and offers a coherent loss-of-governance mechanism, but downstream prose should mark it only as a root-level lexical echo, not as the phrase's translation.

activation_trace.role: Authority and its holder supply the absent governing center in the exploratory image.
Released grazing and animals left without a keeper picture action dispersed across an open field.

changed_reading.before: Their affair contains many confused thoughts.
changed_reading.after: Their affair behaves like a domain released without a governing center: movement continues, but nothing tends it toward a shared course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because مريج normally activates mixed disorder, while the trace carries its neighboring مارج-fire image into the later filling-and-more scene; the focus root and the context sequence keep it anchored, but downstream prose should present it as a contained image of escalation rather than identify مريج with fire or predetermine its referent.

activation_trace.role: A branching, intense flame supplies an image of disorder that propagates rather than merely remains tangled.
Filling to the measure of a vessel gives the propagating image a repeatedly approached capacity.
Increase and growth turn the later request for more into a self-feeding escalation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: مريج is a static tangle of incompatible views.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical echo, the tangle can behave like branching flame: denial feeds a disorder that grows toward capacity and still asks for increase.

strongest_changes: The disorder is localized in the deniers' reception and affair, while creation, evidence, and the denied reality remain structurally coherent.
الحق gains a second force as a due claim whose threatened consequence accrues through repeated denial of sent messages.
مريج becomes directional: it is wobble without return, noisy dispute without power to rewrite, and fragmentation unlike the final easy gathering.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package repeatedly counterposed the focus's mixed affair with joined construction, preserved evidence, removable covering, directed return, receptive hearing, and final collection. Those contrasts activated several causal and spatial readings without requiring them to collapse into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The فَهُمْ sequence supports but does not prove that denial causes the mixed affair; it may also identify a condition already accompanying denial.
The martial, pasture, and flame mechanisms depend on branch-distant root images and must remain exploratory rather than lexical replacements.
Several later scenes may retrospectively diagnose 50:5, but they can also function as independent developments of the resurrection argument.
